quote_zh: 步骤a：以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯（化合物I）与三氟乙醇钠为反应底物，加入MOH或M2CO3，在反应溶剂中进行反应，获得2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸（化合物II），具体化学反应式如下式（1）所示：  (conditions and stoichiometry from the qualifying paragraphs: line 105 [0011] 其中，所述步骤a中，M为Li、Na、K离子中的一种。 / line 107 [0012] 进一步地，所述步骤a中，三氟乙醇钠与化合物I的摩尔比为1.1-1.2:1。 / line 112 [0013] 进一步地，所述步骤a中，MOH/M2CO3与化合物I的摩尔比为1-1.5:1。 / line 114 [0014] 进一步地，所述步骤a中，反应温度为0-5℃，反应时间为2-10小时。 / line 124 [0019] 进一步地，所述步骤a或/和步骤b中，反应溶剂为己烷、环己烷、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺、苯、甲苯、二甲苯、二氯甲烷、1,2-二氯乙烷、氯仿、1,4-二氧六环、乙醚、四氢呋喃、乙腈中的一种或多种。 / line 126 [0020] 进一步地，所述反应溶剂与化合物I或化合物II的重量比为2-8:1。)
arithmetic_check: Nothing to close. No mass, volume, mole, equivalent, purity or yield figure is stated for this step or anywhere in this section. Every quantitative statement is a range: molar ratios 1.1-1.2:1 and 1-1.5:1, a solvent weight ratio 2-8:1, 0-5 C, 2-10 h. A range is not a charge, so no mass balance, no molar-mass check and no yield check is possible, and neither mass_balance_implausible nor molar_mass_inconsistent can be assessed. What can be checked is the formula bookkeeping of the transformation, and it supports the two-fold change recorded as one_pot: compound I is C10H10BrClO4S and compound II is C11H10ClF3O5S, so the step both replaces Br by OCH2CF3 and converts CO2CH3 to CO2H. Note for A5: the worked examples, not this section, are where the arithmetic of this route can actually be tested.
drawing_evidence: IMAGE_EXTRACT at line 98, step_id 1. Agrees with the prose on substrate, arrow reagent and product. The span is INCOMPLETE, and this is the point A5 should check against the page image: it lists only one reactant and only the condition MOH/M2CO3.
